svg.title: Full RNN pipeline from input words to predicted output words
svg.desc: Each word is embedded, combined with the previous hidden state inside the RNN cell to produce a new hidden state, which then passes through a linear and softmax layer to predict the next word, with the hidden state also threading forward to the next timestep.
svg.text: Every hidden state feeds its own output head — the "language modelling" row from your table, wired end to end
